thread:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: page fired INC-2024-321 — embeddings-service 5xx spike in eu-west-1. Trigger: 5xx rate > 8% over 5m. Links: https://pagerduty/INC-2024-321, https://grafana/redwood/embeddings
jen.sre: acked. I'm the primary on-call, starting triage now. :eyes:
alex.prod: ping — any immediate customer impact? are production responses failing or timing out?
jen.sre: short: some customers seeing 500s on /v1/embeddings, latency also up. Error rate concentrated on large-batch requests to dedicated pools. looking at logs now.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty ack recorded: jen.sre (Primary) — 1776543230
jen.sre: quick checks i ran:
```
# check queue depth and pod restarts
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=embeddings -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs deploy/embeddings --since=10m | grep ERROR | tail -n 50
# check autoscaler metrics
kubectl -n inference describe hpa embeddings
```
logs excerpt: "kv-cache-miss spike -> sqlite timeout -> 502 upstream"
sam.ops: I can take on remediation if you want. If this is pool saturation we should scale the dedicated pool and/or route to a lighter quantized variant.
jen.sre: handing off active mitigation to sam.ops — I'll keep looking for root cause in parallel. sam, confirmed you want me to attempt a quick pod restart first? :handshake:
sam.ops: yes please, restart the embeddings workers first, then if 5xx persists we'll switch routing to embed-small-v2 fallback. I'll coordinate customer comms.
jen.sre: running restart now:
```
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/embeddings
kubectl -n inference rollout status deployment/embeddings --timeout=120s
```
deploybot: rollout restart triggered for deployment/embeddings by jen.sre — status: in_progress (1776543248)
deploybot: rollout complete for deployment/embeddings — all pods ready (1776543255)
sam.ops: saw restarts. error rate dropped from 9.2% -> 4.6% but still above baseline. traces show repeated KV eviction noise and elevated queue latency. suspect kv cache thrash with recent model change.
chao.platform: i can apply a routing override to divert new requests to embed-small-v2 for eu-west-1. preparing patch now. snippet:
```
# routing override (snippet)
PATCH /api/v1/routing
{
  "region": "eu-west-1",
  "rule": "if model == \"embed-large-v3\" then route -> embed-small-v2",
  "ttl_seconds": 900
}
```
sam.ops: taking ownership: i'm applying the routing override and will monitor success. jen, thanks for the quick restart. handing back investigation to you for logs/root cause timeline. :white_check_mark:
chao.platform: routing override applied (deploy id: r-7721) — switch completed (1776543290)
alex.prod: quick customer impact update: synthetic canaries show 500 rate back to 0.8% and success rate ~99.2% post-switch. customers that hit the 500s earlier reported degraded throughput but no data loss. recommend post-incident comms. :memo:
sam.ops: confirmed mitigation effective. keeping incident open for 30m monitoring. creating incident record and assigning postmortem action items: investigate kv cache tuning, evaluate model variant memory footprint, add runbook for emergency fallback routing.
jen.sre: noted. i'll collect timeline, logs, and the sequence of events (cache thrash after model rollout) and attach to the ticket. thanks team. :pray:
sam.ops: ownership: sam.ops (mitigation), jen.sre (investigation). monitoring window until 1776543500, will escalate if regressions.
alex.prod: please include customer impact summary in the ticket: partial 5xx affecting embeddings in eu-west-1 for ~18m, mitigated via restart + routing fallback. :+1:
sam.ops: creating INC ticket & postmortem stub now. I'll ping you when it's ready for reviews.
jen.sre: closing thread update — leaving a follow-up to deep-dive tomorrow. good job all. :tada:
